name: dev-flow-orchestrator
description: A guarded, resumable Windows, macOS, and Linux workflow for Codex, OpenSpec, Git, and codebase-memory.

interface.shortDescription: Guard and resume Git-to-OpenSpec development work
interface.longDescription: Runs the same guarded state machine on Windows, macOS, and Linux; checks repository baselines, routes explicit baseline/workspace codebase-memory indexes by phase, guides direct or OpenSpec planning, and verifies the complete change before handoff.
defaultPrompt: Start this requirement with the guarded development workflow.
Resume the active development workflow from its saved state.
Review the complete implementation against its approved scope.
